title: [AUG-191] Default Prompt field fills the editor pane + Expand to full-window editor
why_we_need_this: Rodion's feedback (Feature Request 1, @docs/feedback/2026-11-rodion-feedback.md): in Settings → Projects → Default settings the prompt field shows only ~2 lines, so the ~48-line built-in prompt cannot be read or edited comfortably. Root cause (research AUG-172): the textarea at @client/src/components/PraxisProjectsPage.tsx:407 is not wrapped in `.praxis-md-field--grow` like the per-project editor (L513), so it gets no flex:1/min-height, and `.praxis-md-textarea { resize: none }` (@client/src/App.css:7458) blocks dragging. Decision AUG-172 = option B + C on the mockup @docs/mockups/AUG-172/default-prompt.html (sections "B · Fill + auto-grow" and "C · Fill + Expand").
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] B: in Settings → Projects → Default settings the prompt textarea fills all remaining editor-pane height (min 120px), same as the per-project Prompt textarea; with the built-in prompt it shows ≥ 15 lines at a 900px-tall window; long text scrolls inside the field; the footer (Reset to built-in / Custom) stays at the bottom of the pane.
- [ ] C: an outline "⤢ Expand" button sits at the right end of the variable-chips row in BOTH the Default and per-project prompt editors; Ctrl+Shift+E (Windows) / Cmd+Shift+E (macOS) while the prompt textarea is focused does the same.
- [ ] Expand opens a full-window editor overlay (backdrop rgba(0,0,0,.45) + blur(8px), 0 border-radius, card ≈ window minus 48px, title "Default prompt" or "<project name> prompt", variable chips, primary "Done" button); its textarea receives focus and edits the same draft value.
- [ ] Esc or Done closes only the overlay (the Settings modal stays open), returns focus to the Expand button and commits the draft through the existing save path (commitDefault / commitPrompt) — the "Saved" indicator appears; variable chips in the overlay insert at the caret.
- [ ] No height preference is persisted; no diagnostics shown in UI; 0 border-radius on all new elements; light and dark themes match the mockup.
- [ ] Verified on Windows (Electron dev) and the shortcut branch for macOS is a guarded no-op difference only (metaKey vs ctrlKey); `npm run build` / type check passes.
important_constraints: Mockup (chosen B + C): @docs/mockups/AUG-172/default-prompt.html. Research: AUG-172-f9wi5a. Files: @client/src/components/PraxisProjectsPage.tsx (L403-421 default editor, L513-531 project editor, insertVariable L272 uses a single promptRef — the overlay needs its own ref), @client/src/App.css (L7453-7466 praxis-md-*). Expand overlay key handling must stopPropagation so Esc does not close SettingsModal. Do not change prompt resolution or preferences schema. Roadmap: M1 Quick fixes.
